issues.description: The problem statement for Aufgabe 04 requests the number (count) of swimming pools in Gemeinden with more than 1000 female inhabitants, but the solution file returns the names of the Schwimmbäder instead. This mismatch between the expected aggregate result (a single count) and the solution's row-wise result will confuse students and cause tests/graders to disagree with the specification.
issues.suggestedFix: Change the solution query to return a count. For example, replace SELECT Schwimmbad.name with SELECT COUNT(*) AS anzahl_schwimmbaeder and keep the existing FROM/WHERE join and condition (Gemeinde.einwohner_w > 1000) so the query returns a single integer count as requested.
